description_en: Modifies the whitelist for row-level and column-level permissions of a specified dataset
description_zh: 修改指定数据集行列权限的白名单
name: AddDataLevelPermissionWhiteList

parameters.help_en:
The type of permission. Valid values:

ROW_LEVEL: row-level permission

COLUMN_LEVEL: column-level permission
parameters.help_zh:
行级权限类型：

ROW_LEVEL：行级权限，
COLUMN_LEVEL：列级权限
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en:
The operation to perform. Valid values:

ADD: adds users or user groups to the whitelist.

DELETE: removes users or user groups from the whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
操作类型： 

ADD：增加白名单
DELETE：删除白名单
parameters.name: operate_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of object to add to the whitelist. Valid values:

1: user

2: user group
parameters.help_zh:
修改白名单对应的类型：

1：用户 
2：用户组
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the users or user groups to add to the whitelist.

If you set TargetType to 1 (user), specify the user IDs.

When `TargetType=2` (user group), the value is the user group ID
parameters.help_zh:
授权对象，同时支持多个授权对象，多个对象以英文逗号分隔。取值范围：

TargetType=1（用户）时，为用户ID。
TargetType=2（用户组）时，为用户组ID。
parameters.name: target_ids

Result.description_en:
The execution result of the API operation. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Result.description_zh:
接口执行结果。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
